description:
FULLY CUSTOM 3″ steel MTB.

It’s early doors for the OMG but our first fully custom mountain bike offering is coming together.

You won’t get an OMG anywhere else! MADE TO ORDER, OFF MENU, STEELS FOR FEELS MTB DELI-ICIOUSNESS. Currently no standard geo and sizing. All custom, all one off, all unique for the mtb F R E A K. Made to order, of singular construction and delivered individually with all the love and care that we in the STAYER workshop can muster.

The idea is that anything you can think to do with 3″ tyre clearance and a no-suss or hardtail frame can be done with the Groadinger OMG. If you want a big rig for long distance off road touring then we can do that with the OMG. If you want a hardtail with a short wheel base for chopping down the local trail then we can do that with the OMG. So it’s your mountain bike, what are you gonna do? It comes in mullet 29 or 26’er or dropbar with fenders or trail rider, or long distance monster, steel fork feels or carbon for the win, whippy and bouncy, sturdy and looooong with racks, bags and buckets and places to keep your boat or board and so on, and so on.

It doesn’t have to be OTT. It’s just got big tyres. Everything else is TBD.

Seriously though…everything is on the table. Get in touch with your wants and we will make it into a bike shaped thing. If you have geo, cool! If you have nothing but an idea, or a picture or are able to describe the sort of stuff you want to ride thats cool too. We really are here for all of that and everything in between. If your into it drop us a line or fill in the form.

The Stayer OMG is a custom build MTB and will remain so for the foreseeable future. You are going to have to jump on the Deep Dive waiting list (opening soon) over on the custom frames page to get one.

That said, if you are feeling trepidation from the thought of custom then rest assured that you are in safe hands, but also understand that it is a process; ultimately a rewarding one but a process all the same. Drop us a line in the workshop or via this form and we will get on it. We are here to help..and build you a sick bike of course.

In the meantime have a look at our social stations and in the best cycling press for OMG goodies and some sweet builds so far.

Groadinger OG PLUS

Devour single track like it’s your favourite desert, the OG+ is a drop-bar cross-country beast made for thrashing around in the dirt.

Gravel Adventure wheelset

The perfect mate for your gravel bike, available in both 700c and 650b (that’s 27.5) asymmetric drilling and increased hole counts to take whatever you can throw at them.
